title: chore: serve 50% of legacy text cache misses from the worker
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Raises the legacy text API canary from 10% to 50% of Cloudflare cache misses routed to the Worker, continuing the move off the OVH VM. `/feed` remains on the VM until the canary reaches 100%. In a 45-minute run at 10%, the Worker handled about 5,000 misses out of 65,000 requests without exceptions; it passed through gen's 400/422 responses, and its 402 challenges, bodies, and headers matched the VM's.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden server room, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and adjusts a sign sending half the cache-miss paths toward a glowing Worker terminal, while a separate `/feed` path still leads to an old VM. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with chunky sprites, code-plants, and prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow.
